traits.name: Religion
traits.text: +12, Society +14 Str +2, Dex +2, Con +1, Int +4, Wis +3, Cha +0 Items religious symbol, +1 staff.

traits.name: Timely Advice
traits.text: ⬲ (auditory, concentrate, linguistic, mental); Trigger An ally is about to attempt an attack roll or skill check and has not yet rolled Effect The sage gives the ally a savvy piece of advice, providing valuable insight. The ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.

traits.name: Sage's Analysis
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate); The sage studies a creature, attempting an Arcana, Nature, Occultism, Religion, or Society check against the creature's Recall Knowledge DC. On a success, the sage gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and AC against that creature and deals an additional 2d6 (2d6) damage to the creature with weapon attacks. These benefits last for 1 minute or until the sage uses this ability again.
